model.title: Expedited Access to Biosimilars Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY)

summary.text: The bill would remove the general requirement that companies seeking approval for a biosimilar, a copy of a brand-name biological product such as a drug or vaccine, submit a clinical efficacy study. The Food and Drug Administration could still require such a study when it decides one is necessary, and would have to give the applicant a written reason for that decision within a set period. The bill would also drop the requirement that a biosimilar application be reviewed by the same FDA division that reviews the brand-name product's application.
